content.practice: Deep sensors, spillways, sacrificial vents, and local evacuation law form one permanent institution.
content.consequence: Pressure is managed, not erased; lake chemistry changes, minor eruptions become routine, and the Crown gains authority over settlement.
content.failure: It suppresses warnings to preserve calm, sacrifices an unrepresented district, or stores pressure beneath a perfect surface.
content.safeShedding: Enter a stable idle state and release Span before an anchor begins storing uncontrolled debt.
content.counterplay: Blind sensors, capture evacuation law, block a vent, or falsify population maps.
content.mastery: Mastery lies in regular small releases, public bad news, and the willingness to abandon the Crown's appearance of control.

content.purpose: Takes one disastrous season and tempers it into a survivable relation of heat, cold, rain, drought, harvest, disease, and migration without pretending it never occurred.
content.practice: Every region contributes losses it will accept, states it hopes to restore, and changes it insists on keeping.
content.consequence: The season becomes a negotiated artifact; displaced extremes and political resentment persist into later years.
content.failure: The rite restores an unjust old normal, smooths all difference into sterile weather, or postpones catastrophe into the next season.
content.safeShedding: End spectacle, symbolism, and audience effects before loosening safety Knots.
content.counterplay: Withdraw a region, falsify accepted loss, overload a sink, or introduce a new crisis after the target state is fixed.
content.mastery: The seasonal masters leave revision points, visible debt, and enough disorder for the living world to adapt.
